people.description: Holders by lower-case identifier, counted once each.

attribute.description: The attribute the manifest's rule reads; empty for a rule no longer declared.

lastRejected.description: The reading at which the rule's `reject` counter last grew, inside seven days.

RuleCount.description: One failing rule of a space: a SHACL component and the path it is about.

examples.description: At most five ids of entities that break it.

RunContext.description:
Everything the proxy needs to decide one request, and nothing a workspace may see.

This is the one place the ticket hash leaves the Portal, and it leaves on the internal
listener alone. The budgets are read from the profile at answer time rather than copied into
the run row, so lowering a profile's ceiling takes effect on the runs already in flight.

endpointSlugs.description:
Every endpoint slug of the run, the primary first: what `/v1/data/endpoints/{slug}/…`
may address (Architecture/19 §4).

kind.description: The run's kind: whose daily model budget its calls count against (AG-97).

maxEgressBytesPerRun.description:
The profile's `egress.maxBytesPerRun`: what the run may read from the allow-listed hosts
in total, counted by the proxy's fetch route. Zero for a profile that names no host, and
a run with zero reaches nothing (AG-50, AG-65).

pathPrefix.description: The folder the run writes, as its repository spells it.

reasoningEffort.description: The profile's `model.reasoningEffort`: the proxy adds it to every model call (AG-72).

repository.description:
The project's own repository in layout 2, the one repository the proxy's forge route
reaches for this run (CC-87, AG-86); absent, the configuration repository.

stepsPerRun.description:
The profile's `limits.stepsPerRun`: the proxy counts one model call per step and refuses
the call past it, so a run stops at the limit however its driver loops (AG-25, AG-51).

RunList.description: One page of runs, newest first.

Scope.description:
What a workspace covers (CC-76, API/01 §22): the whole project, one space and what it
holds, or a list of resources.

SecretWrite.description: What the form sends: the whole secret, every key of it.

name.description: The secret's name, letters, digits, `-` and `_`, e.g. `counters-api`.

values.description:
Each key with its value, e.g. `{"apiKey": "…"}`. A secret that exists already is replaced
whole, so every key it keeps is sent again.

SegmentKinds.description: One preset and the kinds it reaches, e.g. `pipeline`: `Pipeline`, `DataSource`, ...

SetupItem.description: One step or operator item and whether it is done.

ShareBody.description:
The body of a share: the model's name typed back by an organization administrator who
approves their own share at once (PF-58, CC-19). Without it the Change waits for one.

SharedApp.description: One App another project shared with the caller's organization (AP-174).

title.description: One string, or a map per locale (UI-50).

SharedFrom.description:
Where an organization model was shared from (DM-77): what lets that project offer to use the
organization's copy instead of its own (DM-78).

Side.description: Which side a person kept for one conflicting field (CC-80).

action.description: A CIM 009 operation name, such as `retrieveEntity`.

type.description: The entity type the question is about; absent asks about any type.

policy.description: The manifest name of the Policy that decided, when one did.

reason.description: `policy_grant_matched`, `prohibited`, `no_grant` or `not_admitted`.

SpaceBytes.description: A space's storage in bytes, as the broker measures it in its store (T-2890).

attrInstances.description: The history: the space's temporal attribute instances.

byType.description: The current state by each Entity's first type (expanded IRI); sums to `entities`.

entities.description: The current state: every Entity of the space.

at.description: The newest reading; `null` while there is none.

bytes.description: The entities and history the broker measured; absent when it did not answer.

reason.description: Why `bytes` is missing.

SpaceMapping.description: One space of the origin mapped onto a space of the target project (T-1441).

SpaceQuality.description: What one run found in one space.

types.description:
Per entity type: how complete each attribute is, the newest change, numeric ranges and
outliers (T-3252).

attrInstances.description:
The space's history: its temporal attribute instances, as the broker counts them; absent
when the broker could neither count nor estimate them (T-6085).

broker.description: The `ContextBroker` the space lives on, which counted it (PF-111).

oneOf.description:
The storage the space takes, measured by the broker; absent when the broker cannot
measure it or holds no tenant for the space yet.

entities.description: The entities of the space's tenant, as the broker counts them.

estimated.description:
True when the broker took the history count and size from its database's statistics,
because the history was too long to count within its bound (T-6085).

measuredAt.description:
When the broker measured the size: its own `measuredAt` (it keeps a size five minutes),
else when it answered (T-6208).

infrastructure.description: The table: what the cloud bills, which the projects and the platform add up to.

StandardGuide.description: One query standard the Endpoint serves.

fields.description: The names this standard filters on.

first.description:
The first five entities of the example type in this standard, kept only when that call
answered with entities.

StartConversation.description: Request payload for starting or continuing an assistant conversation.

oneOf.description: The capabilities the person chose (AG-92, T-2718): they only narrow.

endpointNames.description: The endpoints the person chose, zero to five, which the assistant may query (AG-75).

oneOf.description:
Where the person is standing when they ask (UI-61, AG-77): the form that is open, the draft
it edits and the field they were last in. Values never travel here; the assistant reads the
person's own draft with `jc_draft_get` under their own grants.

The page the person is on (T-2763, API/04 §"Start or Continue"): its route, read against
the Portal's page table, names only.
One path, as the request and the `path` event spell it.

path.description: The path the person picked in the empty assistant (AG-87, ADR-N-032).

Status.description:
The status the Portal API reports (MF-04). It is `jc_core::Status` plus `sourceUrl` and a phase
that is always known; it stays a Portal type until jc-core carries `sourceUrl` too (docs API/01
section 6 is the contract), then it becomes a re-export like its neighbours.

build.description:
What the build lane published for an `App`, and the only place its artifact is named
(AP-13a). The one member of `status` a proposal may carry, and only from the role whose
`propose` on `App` is constrained to it (AP-73).

oneOf.description:
Whether an Organization owns the domain it declares (PF-41): computed by the reconciler,
never read from Git, and only ever on an Organization.

jobs.description:
The last run of each scheduled job of a `wasm` App, as its shard reports it (AP-154):
computed by the reconciler, never read from Git.

oneOf.description:
What a `Subscription`'s space reports of its deliveries (T-4866): computed by the
reconciler after each write, never read from Git, and only ever on a Subscription.

shard.description:
The WASM host shard a `wasm` App runs on, recorded at its first publish and kept; the
Portal writes it in the publish commit, never a proposal (AP-149).

sourceUrl.description:
Forge page of the file this manifest was read from, so a view can link "Source"
without knowing where a kind lives in the repository. Computed, never read from Git.

Step.description: One step of the dry run.

reason.description: In words, never a value of the payload or a token.

StoredSecret.description: A secret the repository declares: its name and keys, never a value.

keys.description: Its keys, e.g. `["apiKey"]`; empty for a secret holding one value.

path.description: The repository file that holds it.

SubjectRequest.description: A request about one data subject.

reason.description: Why, for the audit record: the request's reference, the legal ground.

subject.description: The value of the class's `dataSubjectRef` slot.

SubscriptionDeliveries.description:
What the space says of one subscription's deliveries (TS 104 175 §5.2.14, the
NotificationParams members the broker maintains), kept in `status.notifications` so a person
sees whether the receiver gets what it watches (T-4866). Never the endpoint, a header or a
payload: only an outcome, two counts and three instants.

status.description: `ok` when the last notification was delivered, `failed` when it was not.

SurfaceFit.description: What one space's model serves of the surfaces that need a model.

dataModel.description:
The DataModel the surfaces are judged by, the one the form links to; none for a space
without its own model.

surfaces.description: One row per representation that needs the model (`sta`, `ical`).

SurfaceGap.description: One representation and why the model cannot serve it.

gap.description:
The sentence propose refuses it with; none when the model serves it. `ical` is judged by
its mapping as well, which the form checks on save.
gap.example: `sta` needs a type with a numeric attribute that declares its unit

representation.description: The representation's wire name, as `enabledRepresentations` lists it.

SyncRunReport.description: What one run did, and where the source stands afterwards.

flags.description: What the run could not do, in sentences a person can act on.

proposed.description: The `kind: Change` envelope of every merge request the run opened.

unchanged.description: Whether the run changed anything at all.

SyncSourceStatus.description: What the project page shows for one source (MF-30).

durable.description:
Whether a restart keeps this. `false` on a Portal without a database, where a restart
costs one duplicate proposal per source with a run in flight.

lastError.description: Why the last run did not finish, when it did not.

lastRunAt.description: When the last run happened, in seconds since the epoch.

mergeRequest.description: The merge request a run opened and nobody has answered yet.

observedRevision.description: The source revision the repository carries.

SyncStatus.description:
Status of the background Git mirror synchronization.

Served to the browser, so it deliberately never carries a token,
repository URL, or branch name.

leader.description:
Whether this replica is the one that reconciles (CC-03). A Portal without a database
has no election to run and reconciles on its own, so it reports itself as the leader.

Template.description:
One template as a person picks it (T-3263, AP-141): what it is for, for whom, and the data
it needs; the source stays the model's.

access.description: Who may read and write what it shows, in the sample's words.

dataNeeds.description: The types, attributes and operations it reads, as the sample declares them.

name.description: The name a prompt names it by: `(template: {name})`.

TemplateApp.description: What the person chooses: the App's name and the Endpoint it reads.

endpointName.description: The project's Endpoint the App reads, one the caller may read.

name.description: The App's name, a DNS-1123 label: `kpi-board`.

rows.description: One row per pipeline, entity type and attribute, by pipeline, type and attribute.

unread.description: The pipelines whose `bento.yaml` the forge did not answer: their rows may be missing.

TemporalAuditRow.description: One row of the audit (T-4844). Names and sources only: no value of the data.

datasetId.description: The literal `datasetId`s, or `mapped` for one the record decides.

history.description: How long the type's rows are kept: the rule's, the space's `*` rule's, or the platform's.

lifetime.description: What ends the entities: the pipeline's `lifetime` and `expiry`, or an `expiresAt` it maps.

unitCode.description: The codes the mapping writes, or the model's unit as `model <code>` when it writes none.

TemporalVerdict.description: What the rows of one attribute come to.

TenantDigest.description: A broker's digest of one tenant (Antares ADR-0030).

TestPublish.description: One message a ServiceAccount would publish (API/01 §44a).

account.description: A ServiceAccount the broker's roles name, e.g. `cam-west`.

payload.description: The message as the device sends it, text or JSON.

topic.description: The topic the device publishes on, no wildcard, e.g. `cameras/helsinki-cam-west/frame`.

sample.description: What the harness reads, read through `SampleRequest`, whose shape the document publishes.

anyOf.description: The form every new manifest writes.

Text.description: A human label or description (UI-50): one plain string in the author's language. The legacy language map is still read, through release `v0.9`, and resolves to one string.

TrashItem.description: One deleted entity, as its keeper read it.

expiresAt.description: RFC 3339: when the copy is gone.

TypeGrant.description: One entity type and the attributes asked for on it, each written out.

TypeQuality.description: What one run found of one entity type.

attributes.description: Every attribute an entity of the type carries, the most complete first.

Unit.description: A quantity's unit: the UN/CEFACT code NGSI-LD's `unitCode` carries, and its UCUM spelling.

merged.description: Files both changed, merged field by field and checked again.

taken.description: Files main changed that the workspace had not touched, now as main has them.

UpdateRequest.description: What updating a workspace from main asks for: the answer to every conflict (CC-80).

expectedVersion.description: The version read; a save against a newer view is refused instead of overwriting it.

Usage.description: One quota dimension of a project: what it holds and what it may (PF-75).

limit.description: Absent when no quota limits this dimension.

oneOf.description:
A Pipeline's record check (T-4840): what its sample's records got from the space's model,
the target Endpoint and the lifetime. A later check of another kind keeps it, and the
proposal of a Pipeline needs it green and fresh for the spec it proposes.

waitsOn.description:
The open changes whose resources this manifest names (MF-48): it resolves once they are
approved, and its own change cannot merge before them. Empty for every other verdict.

Verified.description: One file of a bundle as the import verified it (MF-42).

path.description: The path the bundle index gave the file.

Version.description: Both halves of the Portal and whether the UI was built against this binary's API (T-2485).

contract.description: `match`, `mismatch`, or `unknown` when the bundle names no hash.

oneOf.description: `None` when the bundle is unreachable or carries no `version.json`.

ViewConfig.description: How a view looks at its type (API/01 §30).

group.description: An enum attribute the rows are grouped by.

labels.description: A label of the view's own, by attribute: shown as text, the model keeps its own (T-4827).

order.description: The columns in the order the view shows them, by attribute; the rest follow (T-4827).

q.description: An NGSI-LD query, sent as the person's own `q` when the view opens.

settings.description: The view kind's own settings: card fields, the kanban's attribute, a calendar's dates.

width.description: Column widths in pixels, by attribute.

items.description: The views of the space this caller sees, oldest first.

endpointTitle.description: The Endpoint's title, the name its dropdown shows.

openUrl.description: Where it opens in Grafana; `None` until the organization is known.

connected.description: The account's connected clients now; `null` when the broker is not measured.

messagesPerSecond.description: The broker's messages per second now; `null` when not measured.

reason.description: Why refusals or measurements are missing, in words.

refusals.description: Newest first; empty when `refusalsRead` is false.

oneOf.description: A person, by their Keycloak user id.
A member of the realm group `name`.
A holder of the realm role `name`.
The project's ServiceAccount `name`.
The anonymous caller.

Who.description:
Who is tried: one person, a member of a group or of a realm role with no person of their own,
one of the project's ServiceAccounts, or the public.

Windows.description: Where each window starts: its oldest reading.

Withheld.description: Why an attribute stays out of a public dataset.

WorkflowRun.description: A workflow run of an application's repository, as the App page links it (AP-86, AP-103).

number.description:
The run's number in its repository, so a client tells the run it started from the one
before it (T-3245).

startedAt.description: RFC 3339, once a runner took it.

status.description: `queued`, `in_progress`, `waiting` or `completed`, as the forge says it.

url.description: The run's page, behind the forge's sign-in (PF-81).

changes.description: How many files it changes; read only when one workspace is asked for.

WorkspaceView.description: A workspace as the API answers it.
